evidence.reason: The symlink branch calls path.stat(), then line 695 silently continues for any non-regular target. A symlink such as backup.service.d pointing to a directory is therefore skipped entirely, even though systemd resolves that drop-in directory and reads its .conf files. A Wants/Requires in such a drop-in can be missed while discovery still reports a complete/supported observation. Reporting incomplete for that traversable directory preserves the no-follow policy and fixes the intended dependency-scan completeness rather than adding a new protection requirement.
